name: Compute Cluster S06: Lookback Memory
description: Tests: valuewhen for sparse historical access.
source:
src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c
ret = returns(close)

# Sparse signal
big_up = ret > 0.02

# Last occurrence value
last_big = valuewhen()(big_up, close)

xy_lines(title='Lookback Memory', category='Memory', series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[LineSeriesSpec(name='Last Big Up Close', color=Color.Blue)]))(x_values=index(), y_values=last_big)
